name: Alpenpizza
kurzbeschreibung: Alpenpizza in Tirol Discover the unique charm of Alpenpizza—a hearty twist on classic pizza, born in the rugged landscapes of Tirol.
beschreibung: The **Alpenpizza** in **Kufstein** is the perfect spot for a quick yet delicious pick-me-up. With a varied selection of warm and cold snacks, savory bites, and sweet treats, there’s something for everyone. Every dish is prepared with care and fresh ingredients—whether it’s hearty sausage specialties, crispy schnitzel in rolls, or vegetarian options. The friendly team ensures fast service and a smile on every guest’s face. Perfect for a break while exploring the region, a quick lunch, or a handy snack on the go—**Alpenpizza** delivers solid quality at fair prices in **Kufstein**.
